flavor.phonemic_palette: Nguni/Zulu (Bantu): click consonants c(dental)/q(palatal)/x(lateral) and their nasal/voiced variants; prenasalized stops mb/nd/ng/nj; lateral fricatives hl/dl; aspirated ph/th/kh; voiced bh/dh; CV(N) syllables, no consonant clusters but the nasal+stop onsets; penultimate vowel-lengthening stress; noun-class prefixes um-/aba- (people), isi-/izi- (manner/thing), ama- (collective), i(li)-/ama- ; theophoric stems are the Nguni-shifted Ge'ez canon morphs (uMarakela-, uWalandela-, uVakida-).

religion_hooks.alignment_lens: Resolved per the culture's chosen alignment (setting-lore §4.2): Lawful venerates the 12 Lawful powers and names the 13 as demons; Chaotic venerates the 13 and names the 12 as tyrant-gods; Neutral venerates this culture's ancestral saints, invoking the great gods only situationally.

flavor_text.one_line: Shaka — wary clan confederation of the savanna; honor, strength.
flavor_text.one_paragraph: The Shaka () are a expansionist clan confederation people seeded in savanna, jungle. They prize honor, strength, glory, lean toward the military sphere, and field heavy_infantry, light_infantry, militia. Outsiders are met as wary; their patrons touch war, death, storms.
